steps.content: The battle is over, and you are taken to the upper levels. Many execs are wounded or captured, and Taran is on the comm with someone.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Sorry, I screwed up again. I can never do this negotiation thing well.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Yeah, it's all done. The lapdogs are controlled. Some of them are hurt, but the non-combatants are fine. Dudu and that Chief have been brought back, and they're safe.
steps.female_content: Yeah, it's all done. The lapdogs are controlled. Some of them are hurt, but the non-combatants are fine. Dudu and ${PlayerName} are brought back, and they're safe.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: But that bastard got away. I should have been more careful and just killed him. Would he...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...I see. How much time do we have? I'll deal with it now. If it comes to it, we still have him as a hostage.
steps.female_content: ...I see. How much time do we have? I'll deal with it now. If it comes to it, we still have her as a hostage.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Okay, understood. This is my mess, and I will take care of it. No matter what happens, please don't leave or show up.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: You can't be targeted.
He hangs up and sends the unconscious Dudu to Greta's side.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Doctor, if she wakes up, ask her if she could come and help.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: But she's not...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Rustfire needs her power.
Greta is too terrified to say anything. He just nods, takes Dudu, and watches Taran walk to the armed forces.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The enemies will be here soon. Everyone, check your gear and take care of your injuries. We will gather and set out in 10 minutes.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: We just finished analyzing the intercepted signal. Those bastards already gave instructions to attack earlier. Fight back or not, we are facing the same situation.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Now we need to protect Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: If you could calm down, there may be room for mediation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I could at least talk to them for you instead of being used as a hostage.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: There is nothing to mediate with them. Sooner or later, it will always come to this. I will take responsibility.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Take ${PlayerName} away as well, and watch the Sinners so they don't get a chance to get them back.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You little...!
Before an argument could start, a roar comes from outside the camp, and the crowd stirs. An armed sentry stumbles back, her face pale.

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: Taran! It's here! It's...

steps.speaker: Drifter Camp Force
steps.content: A monster!!!
